subject: clouded leopard
title: A 50-Pound Cat With a Tiger's Fangs That Walks Down Trees Headfirst

scenes.text: This cat weighs 50 pounds. Its fangs are the same length as a tiger's.
The clouded leopard of Southeast Asia. Two-inch canines, the longest of any living cat for its skull size.
A tiger is ten times its weight. The clouded leopard can open its jaws to about 100 degrees, wider than any other cat.
Its ankles rotate backward. It climbs down trunks headfirst, hangs from branches by its back feet, and hunts monkeys in the canopy.
The tail is as long as its body, up to 33 inches, for balance on branches no bigger than your arm.
Fewer than ten wild ones have ever worn a radio collar. The cat with a tiger's teeth is still mostly a mystery.

description:
The clouded leopard weighs up to about 50 pounds, yet its 2-inch canine teeth are the longest of any living cat relative to skull size, matching a tiger's.
Its rotating ankle bones let it climb down trees headfirst and hang from branches by its hind feet, and its tail can be as long as its body. It hunts gibbons, macaques, slow lorises and small deer. Fewer than 10,000 remain in the wild, and fewer than 10 have ever been radio-collared.
Which cat would you rather meet in a tree? Comment below.
first_comment: The clouded leopard split from the other big cats over 6 million years ago, making it the most ancient line of cats alive. Which rare cat should we cover next?
